correctness.rationale: PASS: At delta=0, hot sites 0 and 3 reset autonomously; spins (X,U,V,Y) form a closed four-spin Markov subsystem. Stationary generator equations give D=16-ab and <XU>=4a/D, <XV>=<UY>=ab/D, <XY>=0, <UV>=4(a+b)/D, <VY>=4b/D, <XUVY>=ab/D. Hence literal ordered-pair product defect F0= -a^2*b^2/D^2 and connected 4th cumulant -2a^2*b^2/D^2. Independently solved all sixteen stationary generator states using exact rational linear algebra for a=1/2,b=1/3 and got defect -1/9025. A shared marked-clock coupling of perturbed and hot-reference systems tracks a backward single ancestry until reset; probability of a different outcome at the first reference-hot reset is <=delta. For products of k spins, discrepancy <=2k delta, yielding |Fdelta-F0|<=8delta+4delta+4delta=16delta for every ring N and the infinite system (max copy probability<1 ensures ancestry termination). Thus for delta=1e-6,a=1/2,b=1/3 the certified upper bound is strictly negative; all baths are then distinct, positive and finite. Finite exact check corroborates local identities, not the infinite-volume coupling.
